【2025 British Mathematical Olympiad Round 2，Problem 4，原题】正整数数列 u_1,u_2,… 满足 u_1=1，且对每个 n≥2 都有 u_{n+1}=(u_n²+u_n+1)^2025/u_{n−1}。问这样的数列有多少个？
【提交的原证明】
第一步：记 F(t)=t²+t+1，e=2025。只要选择 u_2 为正整数，给定 u_1=1 后，有理数递推便唯一确定全部后项；因此需找出恰好哪些 u_2 能使后项全为正整数。注意 F(t)>0 对正数 t 成立，所以只要各次除法合法，所有后项为正。
第二步：由 u_1=1，u_3=F(u_2)^e。按模 u_2 计算，F(u_2)≡1，所以 u_3≡1 (mod u_2)。因为 u_4=F(u_3)^e/u_2 应为整数，所以 u_2 整除 F(u_3)^e≡F(1)^e=3^e (mod u_2)。于是 u_2|3^2025。正因子恰好为 1,3,3²,…,3^2025，共 2026 个，给出可能解数的上界。
第三步：反过来，任取 u_2=3^j（0≤j≤2025），按原递推逐项定义正有理数 u_n。u_3=F(u_2)^e 是整数；第二步同余计算给出 u_2|F(u_3)^e，故 u_4 也是整数。此时 gcd(u_2,u_3)=1，因为 u_3≡1 (mod u_2)；并且 gcd(u_3,u_4)=1，由 u_4u_2=F(u_3)^e≡1 (mod u_3) 得 gcd(u_3,u_2)=1，再结合连续递推，后续相邻项互素性可归纳维护。
第四步：给出归纳核心。设 n≥4，已知到 u_n 为止全为正整数，且连续的相邻项互素。记 b=u_{n−2}, c=u_{n−1}, d=u_n。递推给出 bd=F(c)^e，因此 bd≡1 (mod c)。此外 c u_{n−3}=F(b)^e，所以 F(b)^e≡0 (mod c)。由代数恒等式
b²F(d)=(bd)²+b(bd)+b²≡1+b+b²=F(b) (mod c)，
两侧取 e 次幂，得到 b^{2e}F(d)^e≡F(b)^e≡0 (mod c)。又 gcd(b,c)=1，因此 b^{2e} 在模 c 下可逆，推出 c|F(d)^e。所以 u_{n+1}=F(d)^e/c 是正整数。
第五步：维护归纳所需互素性。由 u_{n+1}c=F(d)^e≡1 (mod d)，得 gcd(u_{n+1},d)=1。初始相邻项的互素性可由 u_3≡1 (mod u_2)、u_4u_2=F(u_3)^e≡1 (mod u_3) 与 gcd(u_2,u_3)=1 推出。于是用强归纳法所有 u_n 都是正整数，而且相邻两项互素。
第六步：因此每一个 3^j（j=0,…,2025）都给出一列符合要求的正整数数列。不同 u_2 确定不同数列，且其他 u_2 无法成立。答案恰好为 2026 列。

result.statement: (Set.ncard {u : {n : ℕ // 1 ≤ n} → ℕ | (∀ k : {n : ℕ // 1 ≤ n}, 0 < u k) ∧ u ⟨1, by omega⟩ = 1 ∧ (∀ (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n), u ⟨n+1, by omega⟩ * u ⟨n-1, by omega⟩ = (u ⟨n, by omega⟩ ^ 2 + u ⟨n, by omega⟩ + 1) ^ 2025)}) = 2026

unsupportedOriginalSteps: source_step_0: The construction of the positive rational/integer sequence from an arbitrary positive integer u₂ and the claim that the recurrence uniquely determines all later terms were not formalized as Lean definitions and induction lemmas.
source_step_1: The modular upper-bound argument u₂ | 3^2025, including the congruence u₃ ≡ 1 mod u₂ and F(u₃)^2025 ≡ 3^2025 mod u₂, was not translated into Lean Nat modular arithmetic lemmas.
source_step_2: The converse construction for u₂ = 3^j, including integrality of u₃,u₄ and the induction setup for coprimality of consecutive terms, was not formalized.

source_step_3: The induction core with b=u_{n−2}, c=u_{n−1}, d=u_n, the identity b²F(d) ≡ F(b) mod c, taking e-th powers, using gcd(b,c)=1 to invert b^{2e}, and concluding c | F(d)^e was not encoded in Lean.
source_step_4: The strong induction maintaining positivity and coprimality of adjacent terms, including the initial coprime cases and preservation at each step, was not formalized.
source_step_5: The final cardinality argument identifying valid sequences exactly with u₂ ∈ {3^j : 0 ≤ j ≤ 2025} and proving Set.ncard of the sequence set equals 2026 was not formalized.
